title: This platform's own stack: run the site's latest template (v2.2: DNS from the site)
why: Template v2.2 (28 Nov 2026), at Dinis's word: the change role may create public hosted zones and add, change and delete NS, A, CNAME and TXT records, so DNS is managed from the Stacks and DNS tab, each change shown as a plan first. No zone deletion, no other record types, no private zones. Note: record changes are allowed in every hosted zone of the account, including zones other systems use (for example the IaC's DNS deploys); the page asks before each change, the role does not. Earlier: v2.1 (23 Nov) fixed security.aws.c's R-001 (the change role could make itself admin); v2 added the S3 browser and let the stack update itself.
summary: Shows the template AWS holds beside the site's; then AWS's own change set; then executes it. Parameters keep their values.
